title: Decode one Vorbis stream in parallel using small overlapping boundaries

definition.title: Decode one Vorbis stream in parallel using small overlapping boundaries
definition.source_excerpt: Split initialized Vorbis packet ranges into independent jobs with a qualified preceding overlap, initially one preceding packet. Verify window transitions, global sample positions, initial/end trimming and complete PCM against continuous decoding.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse.
